description:
Given the parts of a UI (elements, a description, or Screenrove screen ids; from a screenshot,
list the parts you see), returns motion entries and sounds that would improve each part, plus
new touches it doesn't have yet (additions), not only replacements. Then get_motion each one.

description.description: The UI in a sentence or two

elements.description: Comma-separated parts, e.g. "save button, search field, results grid, toast, AI chat".

screens.description: Comma-separated Screenrove screen ids; their tagged components become the parts.

name: suggest_polish
title: Suggest motion and sound polish for a UI
